headline: GST: Final merit list published for 20 universities
summary: Students have until July 5 to complete primary admission and submit original documents to secure their seats.
details: The fifth and final 'subject choice' merit list for undergraduate (honors) first-year admission to 20 general, science, and technology universities under the GST cluster has been published.
The results were released on the Friday night (July 3) via the official GST admission website.
Students selected in the fifth merit list must complete their primary admission online from July 4 at 12:00 PM to July 5 at 12:00 PM, paying a fee of 5,000 BDT.

Following online payment, students must physically visit any of the cluster universities between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM on July 5 to submit their original SSC and HSC (or equivalent) mark sheets in an A4 envelope.
Failure to complete primary admission within the deadline will result in the loss of the opportunity to enroll in any GST university.
Students who opt to 'stop migration' for a specific department between July 4 and July 5 will no longer be eligible for automatic migration to other departments.
According to the core committee, final admission will take place from July 8 to 13, and classes for the first-year students will begin simultaneously across all universities on July 15.
caption:
The final chance for GST university hopefuls is here. The 5th merit list is out!

The fifth and final 'subject choice' merit list for undergraduate (honors) first-year admission to 20 general, science, and technology universities under the GST cluster has been published.

The results were released on the Friday night (July 3) via the official GST admission website.

Students selected in the fifth merit list must complete their primary admission online from July 4 at 12:00 PM to July 5 at 12:00 PM, paying a fee of 5,000 BDT.

Following online payment, students must physically visit any of the cluster universities between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM on July 5 to submit their original SSC and HSC (or equivalent) mark sheets in an A4 envelope.

Failure to complete primary admission within the deadline will result in the loss of the opportunity to enroll in any GST university.

Students who opt to 'stop migration' for a specific department between July 4 and July 5 will no longer be eligible for automatic migration to other departments.

According to the core committee, final admission will take place from July 8 to 13, and classes for the first-year students will begin simultaneously across all universities on July 15.

Source: Prothom Alo

headline: Actresses Shaon and Mahi among 3 GD filed against trio for mocking July uprising
summary: Rashtra Sanglap Forum lodged the complaint at Shahbagh Police Station, alleging the women disrespected the movement's memorial and called it a 'drama'.
details: A general diary (GD) has been filed against actresses Meher Afroz Shaon and Mahiya Mahi, along with Shanta Farjana, for allegedly mocking the July uprising and its memorial on social media.
caption:
Actresses Meher Afroz Shaon and Mahiya Mahi are facing legal heat after a GD was filed against them for allegedly mocking the July uprising.

A general diary (GD) has been filed against actresses Meher Afroz Shaon and Mahiya Mahi, along with Shanta Farjana, for allegedly mocking the July uprising and its memorial on social media.
